entities.name: PMID:25091227
observations: Retrospective cohort: rectus-sparing PAO (31 patients) versus rectus takedown (44); postoperative radiographs showed no compromised acetabular reorientation, fragment mobilization, or final positioning. Level III evidence.

entities.name: PMID:25053288
observations: Retrospective matched cohort: rectus-preserving versus classic PAO, 32 patients per group; lateral and anterior center-edge angles and Tönnis angle improved similarly; authors concluded radiographic correction was comparable.

entities.name: Rectus-sparing PAO correction
observations: Two retrospective comparative cohorts found no evidence that preserving the rectus femoris origin compromises acetabular radiographic correction; one explicitly reported preserved fragment mobilization and final positioning.
